text:
ana (People Ops): keeping this thread open for quick follow-ups from the all-hands about hub rules, travel, offsites, and the new pilots. drop short Qs and we'll reply here. :wave:
matt (Eng): is the updated per-person offsite cap per head or per invoice? planning a ~30p offsite.
claire (Product): also, do >$5k events still need manager + finance approval?
jeff (Finance): caps are per-person for meals+venue; travel and taxes separate. yes, manager + finance sign-off for events over $5k remains. we'll post a sample budget in the policy doc. :memo:
ops-bot: https://intranet.redwood/policies/hybrid-travel (latest draft)
sam (Contractor): badge issue: contractor couldn't badge into Hub-South last week. what's the rule now?
olivia (HR): contractors with recurring onsite work (>10 days in a 30-day window) auto-provision badges. otherwise request day passes via ops@redwood at least 24h before. for urgent same-day access DM @people-ops.
matt (Eng): visa letters turnaround? need one next week for a vendor.
jeff (Finance): typical turnaround is 3 business days after a submitted request + manager confirmation. for urgent requests, subject the email with: ```visa - expedite``` and cc your manager.
claire (Product): desk reservations: can teams reserve blocks for user study days or is it still FCFS?
ana (People Ops): small blocks for interviews/studies can be requested; ops reviews within 48h. default is FCFS for monthly commuter parking.
matt (Eng): childcare reimbursement for required offsite attendance—any change?
olivia (HR): still case-by-case. if childcare is needed to attend a required company event, open a PEOPLE-OPS case with estimate and manager note; we'll route to Finance for approval.
claire (Product): will the coworking stipend pilot overlap with offsite per-diem?
ana (People Ops): stipend is mutually exclusive for the same dates; you can't claim both for the same day. pilot details and signups go live next week.
sam (Contractor): accessibility for evening socials—are non-alc options required?
olivia (HR): yes: vendors must provide at least two non-alcoholic drink options and one low-sensory alternative. ops will add a checklist to vendor briefs.
ana (People Ops): thanks all 97 we'll summarize answers and post a short follow-up in #announcements and update the intranet policy. if you need an exception, DM @ana or tag @people-ops. :white_check_mark:
